name: Goblin Skull
Requirement: Defeat 50 goblins
Description: A yellowed skull with jagged teeth, mounted on a rough wooden plaque.

name: Dragon Head
Requirement: Slay an Ancient Dragon
Description: A massive crimson head with scales that shimmer like rubies, eyes still glowing faintly.

name: Werewolf Fang
Requirement: Defeat a Werewolf during a full moon
Description: A curved ivory fang, stained with dried blood, set in a silver frame.

name: Lich Crown
Requirement: Destroy a Lich and its phylactery
Description: A tarnished iron crown adorned with black gemstones that pulse with necrotic energy.

name: Troll Severed Arm
Requirement: Cleave off a troll's arm
Description: A grotesque green limb, still twitching, nailed to a slab of petrified wood.

name: Hydra Skull
Requirement: Defeat a multi-headed Hydra
Description: A massive bleached skull with seven empty eye sockets, each carved with ancient runes.

name: Minotaur Horn
Requirement: Kill a Minotaur in its own labyrinth
Description: A spiraling obsidian horn, heavy and sharp, wrapped in leather cord.

name: Vampire Heart
Requirement: Defeat a Vampire Lord
Description: A crystallized heart encased in red amber, beating slowly when touched.

name: Skeleton Warlord's Shield
Requirement: Defeat the Skeleton Warlord
Description: A dented iron shield emblazoned with a cracked bone crest, still bearing claw marks.

name: Beholder Eye Stalk
Requirement: Sever an eye stalk from a Beholder
Description: A writhing stalk with a milky eye at its tip, frozen mid-gaze, radiating arcane dread.

name: Orc War Chief's Banner
Requirement: Defeat an Orc War Chief
Description: A tattered blood-red banner with a crude white skull painted on it.

name: Basilisk Fang
Requirement: Survive a Basilisk's petrifying gaze
Description: A long, crystalline fang that refracts light into rainbow patterns, cold to the touch.

name: Ancient Artifact
Requirement: Discover a hidden ruin from the Old Kingdom
Description: A golden disc etched with celestial maps, warm and humming with forgotten power.

name: Lost Treasure of Elara
Requirement: Find the Sunken Vault of Elara
Description: A chest overflowing with coins from a fallen empire, gems glinting like starlight.

name: Deep Sea Pearl
Requirement: Reach the ocean floor in the Abyssal Trench
Description: A luminous pearl the size of a fist, swirling with bioluminescent blue light.

name: Map of the Forgotten Lands
Requirement: Recover a map from a shipwreck
Effect: Reveals hidden paths on the world map
Description: A water-stained parchment with ink that shifts to reveal new locations over time.

name: Starfall Meteorite
Requirement: Witness and retrieve a meteorite impact
Description: A jagged black rock still warm from its descent, threaded with veins of silver.

name: Whispering Compass
Requirement: Solve the puzzle of the Lost Temple
Description: A brass compass whose needle spins toward secrets, whispering directions in an unknown tongue.

name: Phoenix Feather
Requirement: Find the Nest of the Eternal Phoenix
Effect: Auto-resurrect once per day with full health
Description: A blazing feather that never extinguishes, radiating warmth and the scent of ash and flowers.

name: Crystal of Convergence
Requirement: Reach the geographic center of the world
Description: A multifaceted crystal that hums in harmony with ley lines, refracting light into prismatic displays.

name: Masterwork Weapon
Requirement: Forge a weapon with a quality score of 100
Description: A flawless blade of damascus steel, its edge sharp enough to split a hair mid-fall.

name: Perfect Potion
Requirement: Brew a potion with zero flaws
Description: A crystal vial containing liquid that swirls with every color of the spectrum, perfectly balanced.

name: Adamantine Ingot
Requirement: Smelt pure adamantine ore
Description: A dense, dark ingot that absorbs light, impossibly heavy for its size.

name: Enchanted Loom
Requirement: Weave fabric imbued with living magic
Description: A wooden loom threaded with starlight, producing cloth that shifts patterns on its own.

name: Dragon Scale Hammer
Requirement: Craft a tool using dragon scales
Description: A heavy smithing hammer wrapped in iridescent dragon scales, resonating with primal heat.

name: Alchemist's Crown
Requirement: Master all alchemical recipes
Effect: Crafted potions have a chance to double in potency
Description: A circlet of intertwined silver tubes and vials, each containing a different colored reagent.

name: Friends of the Tavern
Requirement: Befriend all tavern patrons in a single town
Description: A wooden tankard engraved with tiny portraits of smiling faces, warm to the touch.

name: Silver Tongue
Requirement: Win 10 persuasion checks in a row
Description: A small silver whistle shaped like a tongue, amplifying the wearer's voice with charm.

name: King's Favor
Requirement: Complete a quest directly for the monarch
Description: A golden seal bearing the king's personal crest, granting audience at any time.

name: Peacemaker's Medallion
Requirement: Resolve a war through diplomacy
Description: A tarnished bronze medallion depicting two hands clasped, warm and calming.

name: Black Market Badge
Requirement: Gain trust of the Thieves' Guild
Description: A small iron token with a shadowy figure, recognized by those who lurk in alleys.

name: Hidden Room Discovery
Requirement: Find a secret room not marked on any map
Description: A dusty stone key that fits no known lock, etched with the symbol of an open door.

name: Developer's Blessing
Requirement: Type the command "I believe in you" at the title screen
Description: A shimmering blue orb containing a message: "Thanks for playing. You matter."

name: The Unkillable Rat
Requirement: Fail to kill the same rat 10 times
Description: A tiny golden rat statue with a mischievous grin, somehow always moving when you look away.

name: Mirror World Access
Requirement: Find and enter the Reflection Gate
Description: A cracked mirror shard reflecting a world where everything is reversed, beautiful and terrifying.

name: The Final Password
Requirement: Discover the 7 hidden words across all zones
Description: A scroll that remains perpetually blank until the correct word is spoken, then glows with golden text.

name: Developer's Easter Egg
Requirement: Find the hidden room in the tutorial area and interact with the developers' memorial
Description: A small bronze plaque reading "In memory of the bugs that made us stronger," surrounded by flowers.
